priority_basis: 基于教学辨义的建议；未使用语料频率或考试官方权重。

core_meanings.reason: 两个片段都表示成为活动的参与者。

records.priority_rationale: 参与某项活动可连接参加与参与，动词结构适合一并提示。

evidence_sources.definition_en: become a participant; be involved in; "enter a race"; "enter an agreement"; "enter a drug treatment program"; "enter negotiations"
share in something

records.priority_rationale: 原文围绕身体与精神的区分，物质存在的含义另列。

evidence_sources.definition_en: involving the body as distinguished from the mind or spirit; "physical exercise"; "physical suffering"; "was sloppy about everything but her physical appearance"
having substance or material existence; perceptible to the senses; "a physical manifestation"; "surrounded by tangible objects"
concerned with material things; "physical properties"; "the physical characteristics of the earth"; "the physical size of a computer"
relating to the sciences dealing with matter and energy; especially physics; "physical sciences"; "physical laws"

records.original_meaning_zh: 名词：偏见，偏差；动词：使产生偏见

core_meanings.reason: 指妨碍客观判断的倾向。
强调外部影响改变判断的动作。

extended_meanings.reason: 抽样或测量的偏差可不涉及个人态度。

source_findings.observation: “偏差”在统计义有方向性或系统性，不是每次偶然误差。

records.priority_rationale: 人的偏见、统计过程的偏差以及使判断偏向的动词有不同的搭配。

evidence_sources.definition_en: a partiality that prevents objective consideration of an issue or situation

evidence_sources.observation_zh: 统计义指抽样等造成的系统性偏差。

evidence_sources.definition_en: cause to be biased
influence in an unfair way; "you are biasing my choice by telling me yours"

core_meanings.reason: 着力使某种品质或本领逐步发展。

extended_meanings.display_zh: 陶冶；通过训练磨炼（能力、品味）
extended_meanings.reason: 两个译词在增进修养或训练本领的条件下成立。

source_findings.observation: 教育、磨炼单独出现容易误导为任意教学行为或经受艰难。

records.priority_rationale: 先记培养能力或兴趣，教育和磨炼都要说明所培养的对象。

evidence_sources.definition_en: foster the growth of

evidence_sources.observation_zh: 可耕作土地、种植作物，也可通过训练增进技能、涵养心智。

evidence_sources.definition_en: teach or refine to be discriminative in taste or judgment; "Cultivate your musical taste"; "Train your tastebuds"; "She is well schooled in poetry"
prepare for crops; "Work the soil"; "cultivate the land"

core_meanings.reason: 给出概念的界定和解释词义共享说明意义的内核。

records.priority_rationale: 由说明词或概念的含义建立记忆。

evidence_sources.definition_en: a concise explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase or symbol
clarity of outline; "exercise had given his muscles superior definition"

core_meanings.display_zh: 文明（文化与社会发展的状态）
core_meanings.reason: 抽象用法描写社会所达到的发展状态。
可数时能指某一社会或历史文化。

other_meanings.reason: 过程义有据，原译容易被理解为个人说教。

source_findings.observation: “教化”需要使社会或人群文明化的语境。

records.priority_rationale: “文明”可指发展状态，“文明社会”可指具有特定文化的社会实体。

evidence_sources.definition_en: a society in an advanced state of social development (e.g., with complex legal and political and religious organizations); "the people slowly progressed from barbarism to civilization"

evidence_sources.observation_zh: 词条分别说明文明状态、特定社会以及使社会文明化的过程。

evidence_sources.definition_en: a particular society at a particular time and place; "early Mayan civilization"
the social process whereby societies achieve an advanced stage of development and organization

core_meanings.reason: 指引起对某人某事注意的话。

extended_meanings.reason: 求职场景中证明资格或可靠性。

records.priority_rationale: 言语里提到、查阅资料和求职推荐涉及三件不同的事。

evidence_sources.definition_en: a remark that calls attention to something or someone; "she made frequent mention of her promotion"; "there was no mention of it"; "the speaker made several references to his wife"
the act of referring or consulting; "reference to an encyclopedia produced the answer"

a formal recommendation by a former employer to a potential future employer describing the person's qualifications and dependability; "requests for character references are all too often answered evasively"

a short note recognizing a source of information or of a quoted passage; "the student's essay failed to list several important citations"; "the acknowledgments are usually printed at the front of a book"; "the article includes mention of similar clinical cases"
a publication (or a passage from a publication) that is referred to; "he carried an armful of references back to his desk"; "he spent hours looking for the source of that quotation"

core_meanings.reason: 比率在此通常以每百份表示，须保留百分语境。

reserved_original_items.reason: “百分之”后面需要数值，是中文表达的一部分，不能独立作名词释义。

source_findings.observation: “百分之”缺少数值，也容易与跟数字连用的 percent 混淆。

records.priority_rationale: 先记百分比这一名词，再处理中文数值表达的断片。

evidence_sources.definition_en: a proportion in relation to a whole (which is usually the amount per hundred)

core_meanings.reason: 形容原因、性质等未能被理解。

records.priority_rationale: 难以理解或说清楚就是神秘感的来源，两种译文能合记。

evidence_sources.definition_en: having an import not apparent to the senses nor obvious to the intelligence; beyond ordinary understanding; "mysterious symbols"; "the mystical style of Blake"; "occult lore"; "the secret learning of the ancients"

of an obscure nature; "the new insurance policy is written without cryptic or mysterious terms"; "a deep dark secret"; "the inscrutable workings of Providence"; "in its mysterious past it encompasses all the dim origins of life"- Rachel Carson; "rituals totally mystifying to visitors from other lands"

core_meanings.reason: 两段均可用于提出某个行动方案。

records.priority_rationale: 先掌握把方案提出来供人考虑的动作。

evidence_sources.definition_en: present for consideration, examination, criticism, etc.; "He proposed a new plan for dealing with terrorism"; "She proposed a new theory of relativity"; "The candidate projects himself as a moderate and a reformer"
make a proposal, declare a plan for something; "the senator proposed to abolish the sales tax"

ask (someone) to marry you; "he popped the question on Sunday night"; "she proposed marriage to the man she had known for only two months"; "The old bachelor finally declared himself to the young woman"
put forward; nominate for appointment to an office or for an honor or position; "The President nominated her as head of the Civil Rights Commission"

core_meanings.reason: 可用于对前述判断的肯定。

dictionary_additions.meaning_zh: （独立应答，带惊讶或怀疑）真的？

records.priority_rationale: 两个原译都表示确认或加强语气。

evidence_sources.definition_en: in truth (often tends to intensify); "they said the car would break down and indeed it did"; "it is very cold indeed"; "was indeed grateful"; "indeed, the rain may still come"; "he did so do it!"
(used as an interjection) an expression of surprise or skepticism or irony etc.; "Wants to marry the butler? Indeed!"

core_meanings.reason: 指对事务进行组织和掌控。

extended_meanings.reason: 两个词在主管事务的语境下是管理职能的表现。

source_findings.observation: “指导、指挥”过宽，单独理解可能偏向教学指导或发号施令。

records.priority_rationale: 从组织、安排事务的管理职能出发，再理解具体情境的指导或指挥。

evidence_sources.definition_en: the act of managing something; "he was given overall management of the program"; "is the direction of the economy a function of government?"
those in charge of running a business

core_meanings.reason: 事实或前提使人得出某个结论。

reserved_original_items.reason: “意思是”太宽，未说明是言外之意还是逻辑蕴含，不能泛指直接说明。

source_findings.observation: “意思是”未显示间接表达或推论。

records.priority_rationale: 说话人含蓄示意与事实所蕴含的后果，需要看主语分辨。

evidence_sources.definition_en: suggest as a logically necessary consequence; in logic
have as a logical consequence; "The water shortage means that we have to stop taking long showers"
have as a necessary feature; "This decision involves many changes"
express or state indirectly

core_meanings.reason: 译词分别强调坚定表态或公开宣布，都可用于正式声明。

records.priority_rationale: 把正式、明确地宣布这一言语动作放在同一组。

evidence_sources.definition_en: state firmly; "He declared that he was innocent"
announce publicly or officially; "The President declared war"
state emphatically and authoritatively; "He declared that he needed more money to carry out the task he was charged with"
make a declaration (of dutiable goods) to a customs official; "Do you have anything to declare?"

core_meanings.reason: 当事人被夺去某物，施事者作主动主语。

reserved_original_items.reason: 单说“丧失”颠倒通常主动结构中的语义角色。

source_findings.observation: deprive 强调使别人失去某物，“丧失”孤立呈现易被学成 lose。

records.priority_rationale: 从施事者剥夺某人所拥有之物的方向记住 deprive someone of something。

evidence_sources.definition_en: take away
keep from having, keeping, or obtaining
take away possessions from someone; "The Nazis stripped the Jews of all their assets"
